limitations: Real symmetric one-spike matrices; independent real Gaussian sketches; fixed dimension, width and power count; exact arithmetic; squared Frobenius loss of the full range projector, not spectral error or general spectra.
scientific_integrity: Derived proof with a recorded, reproducible finite verification script. No claim of independent peer review, exhaustive bibliographic coverage, or performance guarantees for general matrices.
title: A three-regime Gaussian sketch risk law for one-spike matrices
